versions.changelog:
Initial release of OHIF Medical Imaging Viewer deployment tool.

- One-click Docker deployment of the OHIF viewer
- Supports configuration for tbidea, orthanc, DCM4CHEE, and AWS S3 DICOMweb servers
- Allows easy SSL/TLS setup and custom domain configuration
- Production-ready with simple deployment script
- Requires Docker, Docker Compose, and at least 2GB RAM
